html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · November 7, 2022

On Nov 7, 2022, ecom ERP Tokowhale / Jingzhan (鲸绽科技) raised a multi-million RMB angel from White Rabbit Holdings (白兔控股). Beyond cash: JV SEA MCN BaiTube PTE. LTD. for creator signing/incubation. Founded Nov 20, 2021 — Shopify/Shoplazza/WooCommerce ERP (orders, reports, WMS, smart replenishment) for China DTC independents; Mar 2022 pivoted to SEA with Indonesia core.

Why ID: social-seller logic matches domestic brand-seller stack; TikTok ID largest GMV / 100k+ sellers / MCN 2.0; TikTok×BCG: APAC shopping-entertainment $1T by 2025, ID #1 at 26% GMV. Local US ERPs ~¥50k ASP vs Tokowhale ~1/10; FB has Vrich, TikTok ERP underserved. Traction: 500 ID clients, ASP ¥5–10k; expanding TH; 2023 replicate across SEA. Localized pre-purchase for wholesale-market multi-APP restock; live-creator match tool (Feigua-like). Team: Shenzhen R&D + ID local; CEO Stella (Global Sources/Xiaoman/Shoplazza); CPO Zhang Yubo; CTO Tan Zhongtao. White Rabbit: 1,000+ creators incl. Luo Wangyu-class KOLs.

— END —
